# MYTH AI x ZUSHI

> MYTH AI creates fashion products digitally (design, digital samples, factory-ready files). ZUSHI matches them to verified factories and tracks RFQs, production, QC and shipment. One line from sketch to shipment.

## Pages
- https://www.zushixmyth.com/ : joint landing page
- https://www.zushixmyth.com/blog : guides
